judged_text: The INSERT statement interpolates `#{h}` directly into SQL with no escaping or parameter binding. A stored `embeddable_hosts` value containing a single quote (the old setting accepted arbitrary text with no validation) produces a SQL syntax error that crashes db:migrate and blocks the upgrade; the value is also concatenated into SQL unescaped.

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, the migration loops over records from the old site setting and executes raw SQL built via string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. Because `h` comes from `site_settings.value` and is inserted into SQL without escaping/parameter binding, any value containing a single quote will produce invalid SQL and can crash the migration, blocking upgrades. This is directly verifiable from the diff.
